displayName: ExportMate assistant and news: file storage refused or failing

documentation.content: Requests to the assistant's search bucket gs://${BUCKET} (RAG Engine imports from it; the news scan and `npm run index` write to it) were refused (permission) or failed on Google's side. A refused write means files never land: check the writer's role on the bucket (the backend's for the scan, exportmate-ai's for the AI job). GetBucketMetadata refusals are left out: the client asks for them, the object-only role refuses, and reads still work.

conditions.displayName: Refused or failed object requests in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="storage.googleapis.com/api/request_count" AND resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND resource.label.bucket_name="${BUCKET}" AND metric.label.method!="GetBucketMetadata" AND metric.label.response_code=one_of("PERMISSION_DENIED","UNAUTHENTICATED","INTERNAL","UNAVAILABLE","DEADLINE_EXCEEDED")
